children: Sprinklr, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $213.74M and diluted EPS of $0.03, while net income was $7.12M, down from the prior-year quarter as the company absorbed higher cloud and AI-related costs.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “income per share, diluted”.
Subscription revenue grew modestly, up 3% quarter‑over‑quarter (3 months) and 5% year‑to‑date, driven by expansion within existing customers and new customer additions.
Subscription mix increased to 91% of revenue while professional services declined about 20% quarter‑over‑quarter as one‑time implementations eased.
Net dollar expansion exceeded 100% (102.4% TTM), reflecting strong upsell and retention in the installed base.
Higher third‑party cloud, AI and data costs pressured subscription gross margins, contributing to near‑term margin contraction.
Operational actions included completion of global workforce reduction payments and execution of a $125M ASR repurchase under the 2026 program.
